event1.description: woke up when the alarm went off

agent_turn.utterance: What did you do in the morning?

human_turn.utterance: I woke up at 7:30 when my alarm went off. I got out of bed, took a show and got dressed. Next I had breakfast with Lotte and Suzie in our shared kitchen. I had yoghurt with fruit and a coffee. At 9am I went to the university on my bike. It took me about 30 minutes. I went to the library, where I met Lotte again. We studied together for our class using our laptops and readings.
